desplega-ai/agent-swarm.name: Agent Swarm
desplega-ai/agent-swarm.summary: Agent runtime reliability: MCP setup retries, worker readiness, credential checks, and configurable script execution

highlights.description: Retry transient MCP setup failures before a Pi session loses its swarm tools.
Validate ACP targets and commands before workers claim tasks they cannot start.
Make the QuickJS worker pool configurable, with validated concurrency limits.

alibaba/MNN.name: MNN
alibaba/MNN.summary: Edge LLM inference and export: Omni request state, attention masks, AWQ calibration, and QNN embeddings

highlights.description: Refresh stale PLE inputs between successive Omni text requests while preserving multimodal inputs.
Route Omni attention masks by generation or embedding mode to avoid rank-0 mask crashes.
Correct embedding model filenames and tensor IO in QNN export.

uber/NullAway.name: NullAway
uber/NullAway.summary: Java null-safety analysis: constructor initialization checks, Maven-injected fields, and GitHub Actions security auditing

highlights.description: Prevent initialization-check crashes in `@NullMarked` constructors inside unmarked classes.
Treat Maven `@Parameter` fields as externally initialized, avoiding false diagnostics.

HKUDS/nanobot.name: nanobot
HKUDS/nanobot.summary: Agent provider compatibility and messaging: DeepSeek reasoning semantics and Discord reply support

highlights.description: Normalize DeepSeek minimal reasoning effort to low so thinking and tool-call history stay consistent.
Add opt-in Discord replies for regular, attachment, and streaming responses.

microsoft/agent-framework.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
microsoft/agent-framework.summary: Agent orchestration correctness: multimodal handoff preservation and explicit mode validation

highlights.description: Preserve user images, files, and vector-store references during agent handoffs.
Reject explicitly empty mode lists instead of silently falling back to built-in modes.

apple/coremltools.name: Core ML Tools
apple/coremltools.summary: Model conversion correctness: scalar squeeze values and symbolic upsample output shapes

highlights.description: Preserve known upsample dimensions so symbolic 1D interpolation followed by Conv1d converts correctly.
Normalize scalar squeeze results to the MIL input dtype.

reticlehq/reticle.name: Reticle
reticlehq/reticle.summary: Browser verification and setup: expected-failure signals and automatic plain HTML integration

highlights.description: Recognize explicit refusal signals when an expected failure is the correct application outcome.
Automatically connect plain HTML projects with package.json while preserving CSP edits.

QwenLM/qwen-code.name: Qwen Code
QwenLM/qwen-code.summary: Managed-agent API error handling for missing tool publications

adobe/react-spectrum.name: React Spectrum
adobe/react-spectrum.summary: Calendar year-picker correctness at constrained date-range boundaries

highlights.description: Include the final selectable year and clamp its focused date to the allowed range.

microsoft/PyRIT.summary: Accessibility of selected configuration paths in the AI red-teaming interface

google/osv.dev.name: OSV.dev
